title: Encapsulate public mutable state
why: Publicly writable state lets callers bypass invariants and couples them to representation details.
suggestion: Make the field private and expose behavior or a deliberately constrained immutable view.
limitations: Types explicitly named Mutable followed by a domain type name are treated as intentionally mutable containers.
Class and struct declarations must begin a source statement; declaration prose, C# expression-bodied properties and events, and Dart operator declarations are excluded.
